### Asana Plans & Pricing (per user, per month)

- **Personal** (Free forever):
	- **Cost:** $0 (supports up to 2 users)
	- **Features:** Unlimited tasks and projects, list/board/calendar views, and 100MB file storage limit.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXX2w_U--Ck1wSUOyRIkdi4U9cvJN3bvWnsCNBWXODnDTXi-awcfNI8greifvm3bdMiFKOgr2wwGvACmR5Udi6Opb2dmnhXlIfSELL6KdGpun4H)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXZzBLNZ5o3g_n16WIeylFxXWhY1S0cVa-TLBgaJLoi1rbdaIjo9BOme-nWj7ompl1ulZ4h0gFddz-GLyH7CjCt-OSsznN9cdSVDPb-xMB_VIXujfn_bUqXhZLpWMnVg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXipMTHMN9wy16f3c0DZsrW10MW-VAxPWCNlmWm5Ecu387GTF9slBDaXOD_bnY20P08GL4JmpuwE1CZUMOLW7lyV1gCJs2pEMH5OyXGQMPo1YPMy_LjBIxpphUTbmtC3pkaMe5PHkpRSzUgz_N)
- **Starter**:
	- **Cost:** **$10.99 per user/month** (billed annually) or **$13.49 per user/month** (billed monthly).
	- **Features:** Timeline and Gantt views, custom fields, unlimited automations, and AI Studio basic credits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXipMTHMN9wy16f3c0DZsrW10MW-VAxPWCNlmWm5Ecu387GTF9slBDaXOD_bnY20P08GL4JmpuwE1CZUMOLW7lyV1gCJs2pEMH5OyXGQMPo1YPMy_LjBIxpphUTbmtC3pkaMe5PHkpRSzUgz_N)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXDXXm2X5OmzAl6Y636XVXQSLTQscj3ZsJ7i8bSggc9FcBvboATseBkVkjKFR3CZ8rz7TMui2ya3i4eSSTWDbeYFUIShfMY5LPpo0vTOLr7gLdvDs5xUuo5wVNZ0Zitsg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXX2w_U--Ck1wSUOyRIkdi4U9cvJN3bvWnsCNBWXODnDTXi-awcfNI8greifvm3bdMiFKOgr2wwGvACmR5Udi6Opb2dmnhXlIfSELL6KdGpun4H)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXX98dq1TR31yY6Rkpff1bebuQNyOFREGiZ4SFGEixM24mmMNY8NHfL_Fpnwg1p6bP_hAUz9ZrWHytnJbQJnCJHOgoNuPtybOmoFfjYgoeM6om_1-HhI-iTNcEX21jgEG6X)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXpOIEVmCrO7d3wZyCK0ANoHUZzSJd2cmNRZKBiVyDUaiwf_LeWyVyoj0tGrFNww26H9ezLUTlo-yPVnguDnUoQuMFq-2abEGuY41CxnAq7HtAnQ9PwAuS8wdYvYvlRH-4PrLG5rKmYuw)
- **Advanced**:
	- **Cost:** **$24.99 per user/month** (billed annually) or **$30.49 per user/month** (billed monthly).
	- **Features:** Portfolios, goals, resource management, AI meetings, and expanded AI Studio credits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXX2w_U--Ck1wSUOyRIkdi4U9cvJN3bvWnsCNBWXODnDTXi-awcfNI8greifvm3bdMiFKOgr2wwGvACmR5Udi6Opb2dmnhXlIfSELL6KdGpun4H)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXDXXm2X5OmzAl6Y636XVXQSLTQscj3ZsJ7i8bSggc9FcBvboATseBkVkjKFR3CZ8rz7TMui2ya3i4eSSTWDbeYFUIShfMY5LPpo0vTOLr7gLdvDs5xUuo5wVNZ0Zitsg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXX98dq1TR31yY6Rkpff1bebuQNyOFREGiZ4SFGEixM24mmMNY8NHfL_Fpnwg1p6bP_hAUz9ZrWHytnJbQJnCJHOgoNuPtybOmoFfjYgoeM6om_1-HhI-iTNcEX21jgEG6X)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXpOIEVmCrO7d3wZyCK0ANoHUZzSJd2cmNRZKBiVyDUaiwf_LeWyVyoj0tGrFNww26H9ezLUTlo-yPVnguDnUoQuMFq-2abEGuY41CxnAq7HtAnQ9PwAuS8wdYvYvlRH-4PrLG5rKmYuw)
- **Enterprise & Enterprise Plus**:
	- **Cost:** Custom pricing (contact sales).
	- **Features:** SAML, SCIM, advanced admin controls, HIPAA compliance, and data residency options.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXX2w_U--Ck1wSUOyRIkdi4U9cvJN3bvWnsCNBWXODnDTXi-awcfNI8greifvm3bdMiFKOgr2wwGvACmR5Udi6Opb2dmnhXlIfSELL6KdGpun4H)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXDXXm2X5OmzAl6Y636XVXQSLTQscj3ZsJ7i8bSggc9FcBvboATseBkVkjKFR3CZ8rz7TMui2ya3i4eSSTWDbeYFUIShfMY5LPpo0vTOLr7gLdvDs5xUuo5wVNZ0Zitsg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXpOIEVmCrO7d3wZyCK0ANoHUZzSJd2cmNRZKBiVyDUaiwf_LeWyVyoj0tGrFNww26H9ezLUTlo-yPVnguDnUoQuMFq-2abEGuY41CxnAq7HtAnQ9PwAuS8wdYvYvlRH-4PrLG5rKmYuw)

- **Timesheets and Budgets:** $5.99 per user/month (billed annually)

items.description: How much does Asana cost per month? Free for up to 2 users. Starter is $13.49/seat/month ($10.99 annual). Advanced is $30.49/seat/month ($24.99 annual). Read more
